messages:
alex: Draft RN for runtime-service v2.7 ready — need quick ops + eng sanity check before internal blast. Change window: Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC (2h). Canary plan: 15m on dedicated-canary pool, then 30% rollout if green. Rollback criteria I propose: 5% error rate OR 2x median p95 latency vs baseline sustained for 5m. Also planning to pin fallback to runtime-service v2.6 variant. RN draft: https://go/redwood/rn/v2.7 :link:
jessie: LGTM overall. Two asks: call out the quantization compatibility note (customers + private deploys) and add owner for canary monitoring (who is watching dashboards?) :eyes:
sasha: I'll own canary watches and alerts. Can we add a short runbook snippet in the RN with the main dashboards + the alert thresholds?
marco: I can be on-call for the window. Adding the runbook items: what dashboard names exactly?
robin: small copy edit — change "latency spike" to "p99 increase" in the rollback bullets. Also suggest we include example rollback command for Dedicated and Hosted.
alex: thanks — updated RN with kube and deploybot commands. Snippet below for the internal note (feel free to tweak):
```
Release: runtime-service v2.7 (infra + quantization fixes)
Change window: Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC
Canary: dedicated-canary pool, 15m
Rollback criteria: 5% error rate OR p99 >= 2x baseline for >5m
Fallback: pin traffic to runtime-service v2.6 (variant "v2-legacy")
Owners: sasha (canary/watch), marco (oncall/window)
Key commands:
- Hosted fallback: `redwood rollback --service runtime-service --to v2.6`
- Dedicated immediate pin: `deploy-bot pin runtime-service v2-legacy --force`
```
jessie: Nice. Add note: "If telemetry gaps occur, triage with telemetry@redwood and hold rollout". Also can we mute VM autoscaler alerts during the canary?
sasha: I'll mute noisy autoscaler alerts for the 15m canary, add to runbook.
deploy-bot: Scheduling canary for runtime-service v2.7 on dedicated-canary at Tue 02:00 UTC (ID: cb-389012). To cancel: `deploy-bot cancel cb-389012`
marco: I ran through the deploy commands locally, they look good. Confirming I'm on-call and will field pages. Leaving :thumbsup: here.
robin: tiny wording nit: change "pin traffic" -> "route traffic to fallback variant" in the internal blast. Otherwise ready to send once we have final ack from security (I pinged sec).
alex: thanks all. Security ack pending — @security-team can you confirm no additional compliance notes for this rollout?
security-team: (bot) Reviewed. No compliance blockers. Please ensure audit-log retention set to 90 days for this deployment.
alex: great, I'll publish internal announcement at Tue 01:30 UTC with the RN link and on-call roster. Final checklist: sasha watch + mute autoscaler, marco on-call, deploy-bot scheduled. Anything else?
jessie: add a line about expected perf delta for quantized models (~5-8% lower throughput in specific workloads).
alex: added that line. If no objections I'll send at 01:30. :rocket:
